prompt:
A full-fidelity desktop website homepage design comp, landscape, shown flat with no browser frame and no device. This is the website of a Christian nonprofit that provides reconstructive plastic surgery, free or at reduced cost. Visual system: a warm tinted cream ground, white cards with large soft corner radii and gentle shadows, a rounded humanist sans-serif for everything, deep navy text, and one saturated amber color used only on things that can be pressed. Layout:

1. NAVIGATION: at left a text wordmark "Beauty From Ashes" with "Surgical Ministry" in small text beneath; links "Our Mission", "How We Help", "Stories", "Get Involved", "Contact"; at right "EN | ES" and an amber pill button "Give".

2. HERO: LEFT half: small eyebrow "A Christian surgical ministry · Charlotte & Fort Mill"; a very large navy rounded-sans headline over three lines: "Restoring more than what can be seen."; a short amber underline; a paragraph "Reconstructive plastic surgery, free or at reduced cost, for children and adults whose need exceeds their means. Open to everyone."; an amber pill button "Ask for help →" and a plain navy text link "Refer someone". RIGHT half: two stacked white cards. Card one titled "What happens next" lists five numbered steps with short labels: "1 Submit a request", "2 Initial review", "3 Conversation", "4 Decision", "5 Care and support". Card two titled "Ways to help" lists rows with small line icons: "Refer someone", "Volunteer your skills", "Pray with us", "Give monthly", each with a chevron.

3. VALUES ROW (bottom): six small white cards in a row, each with a simple line icon, a bold heading and one line: "We Listen." / "We give every patient the time their story deserves." — "We Protect." / "We hold patient safety as our highest surgical standard." — "We Pray." / "We pray with every patient who welcomes it." — "We Accompany." / "We walk with every patient long after surgery ends." — "We Honor." / "We honor the sacrifice behind every patient's decision." — "We Serve." / "We extend surgical care where need exceeds means."

Overall: friendly, plain-spoken, trustworthy, easy to use; crisp legible typography; realistic modern web UI.
